Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.7

Argo Rollouts

Traffic-weighted canaries and blue-green, with automated analysis and rollback.

WHAT IT IS

Replaces a Deployment with a Rollout: setWeight and pause steps shift traffic, an AnalysisTemplate queries Prometheus, CloudWatch or a job, and a failed analysis rolls back automatically.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Pluggable traffic routers: a mesh, an ingress, ALB, or the Gateway API plugin, which decouples canaries from a mesh decision. Versus Flagger: tighter Argo CD integration and UI.

WHERE WE STAND

Pilot on one user-facing HTTP app. ⚠️ Sources disagree on whether the Gateway API plugin is alpha or stable; check the docs first.

Argo Rollouts docs; ArgoCon AWS cases, KubeCon NA 2026
